desc: convert a PBM image into a Bennet Yee "face" file
r: pbmtoybm - convert a PBM image into a Bennet Yee "face" file

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pbmtoybm reads a PBM image as input and produces as output a file acceptable to the face and xbm programs by Bennet Yee (bsy+@cs.cmu.edu).

There are no command line options defined specifically for pbmtoybm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
